properties.evidence: temporal_tools.rs's add_change_event loop discards DrawnEdges::classify's "already present" answer and calls create_edge with Props{action} for every affected entry; create_edge replaces the stored edge, so the acceptance properties set_artifact_checksum wrote on it are erased.
